<function name="SetMaterial" parent="render" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Sets the material to be used in any upcoming render operation using the <page>render</page>.

Not to be confused with <page>surface.SetMaterial</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="mat" type="IMaterial">The material to be used.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
